verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 905 Country Club Rd., Ojai, California.
verified_facts.excerpt: 905 Country Club Rd., Ojai, California 93023

verified_facts.text: The resort spans 220 acres, with organic herb gardens growing 65 culinary and medicinal herbs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our treasured 220 acres are home to organic herb gardens that showcase 65 diverse culinary and medicinal herbs.

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as a sprawling Spanish revival hotel with towering oak trees and running fountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Time seems to slow down as you pull up to this sprawling Spanish revival hotel. Birds chirp from atop the towering oak trees, and the peacefully running fountains set the tone

verified_facts.text: The Wallace Neff Estate Rooms are named for the original guestroom building created by architect Wallace Neff.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named in honor of the original guestroom building created by famed architect Wallace Neff

verified_facts.text: Filmmaker Frank Capra used Ojai to represent Shangri-La in his film Lost Horizon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Legendary filmmaker Frank Capra found the valley so beautiful he used Ojai to represent Shangri-La in his film, Lost Horizon.

verified_facts.text: Fireside Terrace Rooms have a terrace with seating around a private gas-burning stone fire pit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each guestroom features a spacious terrace with intimate seating around the warmth of your own private gas-burning stone fire pit.

verified_facts.text: The Fireplace Shangri-La Room has an oversized soaking tub, a separate shower and a seating area beside a private fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring an expansive bathroom with an oversized soaking tub and separate shower. A plush seating area beside your private fireplace invites you to relax

verified_facts.text: The Moonrise Penthouse, atop Spa Ojai, has an outdoor terrace with views of the Topatopa Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: also features an expansive outdoor terrace with sublime views of the Topatopa Mountains

verified_facts.text: The Paseo Villas sit beside the Spa Village and are surrounded by a rose garden courtyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled aside the Spa Village, our private Paseo Villas are surrounded by a lush rose garden courtyard.

verified_facts.text: Casa Elar is a gated hillside estate with its own pool and a dedicated Estate Manager.
verified_facts.excerpt: a full acre of hillside privacy, four premium suites, a detached fifth suite to house staff or guests, and a decadent pool with dramatic vistas. Here, your own dedicated Estate Manager will fulfill your whims and wishes.

verified_facts.text: Spa Ojai is a 30,000-square-foot spa focused on natural and organic beauty and wellness practices.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 30,000-square-foot Spa Ojai embraces natural and organic beauty and wellness practices.

verified_facts.text: Pools include the family-friendly Pixie Pool with pool games and the Indigo Pool & Bar, reserved for adults.
verified_facts.excerpt: family-friendly Pixie Pool full of excitement and pool games, to our exclusive adult's only Indigo Pool & Bar

verified_facts.text: The Tranquility Pool and Energy Pool are located at Spa Ojai.
verified_facts.excerpt: For a relaxing experience, visit our Tranquility Pool & Energy Pool located at Spa Ojai.

verified_facts.text: The resort's 18-hole golf course plays 6,292 yards at par 70.
verified_facts.excerpt: This 18-hole golf course plays 6,292 yards with a par 70, rating of 71.0 and a slope of 132.

verified_facts.text: A resident beekeeper leads visits inside a working hive, ending with a tasting of cold-pressed raw honey.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore a day in the life of an apiarist with our resident beekeeper as you hear about the honey-making process, see inside a working hive, spot the queen bee, and savor a tasting of delicious, cold-pressed raw honey.

verified_facts.text: The Artist Cottage & Apothecary offers Open Studio hours for creative activities.
verified_facts.excerpt: We invite you to explore your creative wellness at the Ojai Valley Inn's Artist Cottage & Apothecary during our Open Studio hours.

verified_facts.text: Guided horseback rides through the valley take in views of the Topatopa mountain range.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join our expert guides for a relaxing, hour-long ride through the valley, while you take in breathtaking views of the Topatopa mountain range.

verified_facts.text: Driver-guided open-air jeep tours explore the valley mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Explore our valley mountains with an open-air jeep tour. This driver-guided adventure can be tailored to families, wine lovers, outdoor enthusiasts, or corporate groups.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary daily fitness and wellness classes include yoga, meditation and spinning.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a variety of complimentary fitness and wellness classes presented by our highly qualified team of instructors. Daily classes include Fitness Walks, Yoga, Meditation, Spinning, TRX, and Body Conditioning.

verified_facts.text: Camp Oak offers daily theme-based programming for children ages 4 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bring your little ones (ages 4 to 12) to Camp Oak for daily theme-based programming

verified_facts.text: The Pacific Ocean is 30 minutes from the Inn, where EZ Surf offers surf lessons.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join EZ Surf for a day of local adventure in the gorgeous waters of the Pacific Ocean, just 30 minutes from Ojai Valley Inn.

verified_facts.text: The resort's orchards grow 20 types of fruit trees, including Pixie tangerines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hills and orchards nourish a collection of 20 types of fruit trees, including our famed Pixie tangerines

verified_facts.text: The Oak serves a Sunday brunch buffet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our signature brunch buffet Sunday mornings at The Oak.

verified_facts.text: Hands-on cooking classes are held at The Farmhouse using locally grown ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join our team of culinary professionals as they lead hands-on cooking classes at The Farmhouse. Explore locally grown and regionally raised ingredients

verified_facts.text: Penthouses are for guests without pets; pets are welcome in a variety of other room categories.
verified_facts.excerpt: Penthouses are reserved for guests traveling without pets. We welcome pets in a variety of other room categories at the Inn.

verified_facts.text: Wallace Neff Estate Rooms do not have bathtubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wallace Neff Estate Rooms do not feature bathtubs.

verified_facts.text: Camp Oak requires registration 24 hours in advance.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24-HOUR ADVANCE REGISTRATION REQUIRED.

verified_facts.text: The hotel appears in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards for 2017 through 2023 and 2025.
